goal: Deliver comprehensive, frequency-based automatic QA for the public VII product, including maps, with visible incidents in the administration system.

intent_model.literal_request: Expand automatic QA because known defects, such as maps, are being missed.
intent_model.implied_outcome: A durable regression safety net that tests functions, not merely HTTP availability.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory all public families and critical states.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No broad claim without a coverage ledger.

deferred_complexity: Email delivery until a verified provider and recipients exist

natural_destination: https://vii.spaplus.co/admin/quality and the public VII routes

facts.claim: The current registry contains only eight GET probes.
The public map snapshot probe for vacation-116 currently returns 404.

assumptions.claim: Risk-tier frequencies may be defined by engineering judgment.
assumptions.validation: Admin registry exposes each cadence and user can request a change.

out_of_scope: Real bookings, leads, calls, messages, reviews or payments

requirements.statement: The automatic registry covers every critical public family and API with semantic oracles.
Map snapshot and live-map readiness are explicit monitored outcomes.
Checks run in documented risk-based frequency tiers and are idempotent.
The admin dashboard shows cadence, result evidence and incidents for the expanded registry.
The exact public release is verified after deployment and can roll back.

acceptance_checks.observable_result: Every registered check produces one result and generic 200 fixtures cannot satisfy semantic checks.
Named map check fails and opens one deduplicated incident.

acceptance_checks.setup: Same scheduled bucket is invoked twice
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Second invocation is skipped and performs no fetch.
The expanded run, checks and incident state remain visible.

acceptance_checks.setup: Immutable candidate and previous production version recorded
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Public evidence identifies candidate, active release and rollback identity.

open_questions.question: Which verified email provider and recipient addresses should receive incidents?
open_questions.resolution: Keep delivery visibly disabled until provider and recipients are verified; do not fake sending.

authorization_boundary: Repository work, read-only production tests and the already requested public deployment are authorized. Outbound messages and real customer transactions are not.
